# Analysis overview

This workflow contains two main stages:

1. Preprocess two independent normal-tissue methylation datasets and save the ChAMP-filtered objects as `.Rdata` files.
2. Use these datasets to remove robust hypo-DMRs that are also hypomethylated in normal/background tissues.

The background-filtering criterion is:

- at least 6 available CpG probes in each background dataset;
- the minimum tissue-group mean beta value must be above 0.20 in every background dataset.

## 🍁🍁 step0.data preprocessing

For each normal-tissue dataset, we:

1. Standardized the beta-value matrix and sample IDs.
2. Constructed the tissue phenotype table and aligned it with the beta matrix. As all samples were normal tissues, no Normal/Tumor grouping was required.
3. Applied `champ.filter()` for probe filtering and saved the filtered beta matrix and phenotype table as a `myLoad` object in `.Rdata` format.

## 🍁🍁Step 1: Background filtering in other normal tissues

In this step, we:

1. Loaded the robust validated hypo-DMRs and standardized their genomic coordinates.
2.Loaded the ChAMP-filtered normal-tissue datasets and aligned each beta matrix with its phenotype table.
3.Identified the CpG probes located within each DMR using the corresponding EPIC or 450K annotation.
4.Calculated the regional beta value for each sample and the mean beta value for each tissue group.
5. Retained DMRs with at least six available CpGs and a minimum tissue-group mean beta value above 0.20 in every background dataset.
6.Saved and checked the detailed summaries and final background-filtered DMR list.

#### Load background-filtering packages

```{r load-background-filtering-packages}

rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(IRanges)
library(minfi)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
```

#### Define filtering parameters and input files

```{r define-background-filtering-settings}
## A hypo-DMR passes only when all background tissue-group means are above 0.20.
beta_threshold <- 0.20

## The original discovery criterion was no.cpgs > 5, which is equivalent
## to requiring at least 6 available CpG probes.
min_bg_cpg <- 6L

robust_dmr_file <- "robust_validated_hypo_DMRs_at_least_3datasets.csv"

```

#### Define the output directory for all Step 3 results
```{r}

outdir <- "step3.background filtering in other normal tissues hypo"

## Create the directory if it does not already exist
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) {
  dir.create(
    outdir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}
```

## Define chromosome standardization helper

```{r define-chromosome-helper}
standardize_chr <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))

  keep <- !is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(x))
  x_clean <- trimws(x[keep])
  x_clean <- gsub("^chr", "", x_clean, ignore.case = TRUE)

  x_clean[x_clean == "23"] <- "X"
  x_clean[x_clean == "24"] <- "Y"
  x_clean[x_clean %in% c("M", "MT")] <- "M"

  out[keep] <- paste0("chr", x_clean)
  out
}
```

## Read and standardize robust DMRs

```{r read-robust-dmrs}
dmrs <- fread(robust_dmr_file,data.table = FALSE)

stopifnot(all(c("chr", "start", "end") %in% colnames(dmrs)))

## Preserve an existing DMR identifier whenever possible
dmrs$DMR_ID <- as.character(dmrs$DMR_id)

stopifnot(!anyNA(dmrs$DMR_ID),
  !anyDuplicated(dmrs$DMR_ID))
## Preserve the discovery delta beta when available
## Read the original discovery DMR results
discovery_dmrs <- fread("dmr_hypo_dmrcate_meta.csv",data.table = FALSE)
## Check the available columns
names(discovery_dmrs)
stopifnot(all(dmrs$DMR_id %in% discovery_dmrs$coord))
## Match validated DMRs to the original discovery results
match_index_discovery <- match(dmrs$DMR_id,discovery_dmrs$coord)
stopifnot(!anyNA(match_index_discovery))
dmrs$discovery_deltaBeta <- as.numeric(discovery_dmrs$meandiff[match_index_discovery])

stopifnot(!anyNA(dmrs$discovery_deltaBeta))

head(dmrs[, c("DMR_id",
    "mean_deltaBeta",
    "discovery_deltaBeta")])
```

## Clean DMR coordinates and construct genomic ranges

```{r build-dmr-genomic-ranges}
dmrs$DMR_ID <- as.character(dmrs$DMR_ID)
dmrs$chr <- standardize_chr(dmrs$chr)
dmrs$start <- as.integer(dmrs$start)
dmrs$end <- as.integer(dmrs$end)

## Retain complete, valid autosomal intervals
keep_dmr <-
  !is.na(dmrs$DMR_ID) &
  !is.na(dmrs$chr) &
  !is.na(dmrs$start) &
  !is.na(dmrs$end) &
  dmrs$start <= dmrs$end &
  dmrs$chr %in% paste0("chr", 1:22)

dmrs <- dmrs[keep_dmr, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(dmrs) <- NULL

stopifnot(nrow(dmrs) > 0,!anyDuplicated(dmrs$DMR_ID))

dmr_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = dmrs$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = dmrs$start,
    end = dmrs$end
  ),
  DMR_ID = dmrs$DMR_ID
)

dim(dmrs)
print(head(dmrs[, c("DMR_ID", "chr", "start", "end")]))
```

# Helper functions

## Safely load a ChAMP object from an `.Rdata` file

```{r define-load-myload-function}
load_myLoad_Rdata <- function(file) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop(paste0("File does not exist: ", file))
  }

  tmp_env <- new.env()
  loaded_objects <- load(file, envir = tmp_env)

  if (!"myLoad" %in% loaded_objects) {
    stop(paste0(
      "Object 'myLoad' was not found in ",
      file,
      ". Objects found: ",
      paste(loaded_objects, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  myLoad <- get("myLoad", envir = tmp_env)

  if (!is.list(myLoad) || !all(c("beta", "pd") %in% names(myLoad))) {
    stop(paste0(
      "The myLoad object in ",
      file,
      " must be a list containing beta and pd."
    ))
  }

  myLoad
}
```

## Align a ChAMP beta matrix and phenotype table

```{r define-align-background-data-function}
align_background_data <- function(myLoad, dataset_name) {
  beta <- as.matrix(myLoad$beta)
  storage.mode(beta) <- "double"

  pd <- as.data.frame(myLoad$pd)

  if (
    "ID" %in% colnames(pd) &&
    setequal(as.character(pd$ID), colnames(beta))
  ) {
    rownames(pd) <- as.character(pd$ID)
  }

  if (!setequal(rownames(pd), colnames(beta))) {
    stop(paste0(
      "Sample names in beta and pd do not match for ",
      dataset_name,
      "."
    ))
  }

  pd <- pd[colnames(beta), , drop = FALSE]

  if (!"group" %in% colnames(pd)) {
    stop(paste0(
      "The phenotype table for ",
      dataset_name,
      " does not contain a group column."
    ))
  }

  pd$group <- as.character(pd$group)

  stopifnot(
    identical(colnames(beta), rownames(pd))
  )

  list(beta = beta, pd = pd)
}
```

## Select normal/background samples

```{r define-select-background-samples-function}
select_background_samples <- function(beta, pd, dataset_name) {

  ## Retain samples with valid tissue-group information
  keep <- !is.na(pd$group)

  ## If sample type is available, retain normal samples only
  if ("sample_type" %in% colnames(pd)) {
    keep <- keep & pd$sample_type == "Normal"
  }

  keep[is.na(keep)] <- FALSE

  if (!any(keep)) {
    stop(paste0(
      "No normal/background samples remained in ",
      dataset_name,
      "."
    ))
  }

  beta <- beta[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  pd <- pd[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  stopifnot(
    identical(colnames(beta), rownames(pd))
  )

  list(
    beta = beta,
    pd = pd
  )
}
```

## Load the appropriate hg19 array annotation

```{r define-array-annotation-function}
get_array_annotation <- function(arraytype) {
  arraytype <- toupper(arraytype)

  if (arraytype == "450K") {
    anno <- minfi::getAnnotation(
      IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19
    )
  } else if (arraytype == "EPIC") {
    anno <- minfi::getAnnotation(
      IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19
    )
  } else {
    stop("arraytype must be either '450K' or 'EPIC'.")
  }

  anno <- as.data.frame(anno)

  anno$CpG <- rownames(anno)
  anno$chr <- standardize_chr(anno$chr)
  anno$pos <- as.integer(anno$pos)

  keep <-
    !is.na(anno$CpG) &
    !is.na(anno$chr) &
    !is.na(anno$pos) &
    anno$chr %in% paste0("chr", 1:22)

  anno <- anno[keep, c("CpG", "chr", "pos"), drop = FALSE]
  rownames(anno) <- NULL

  anno
}
```

## Map DMR intervals to CpGs available in one dataset

```{r define-map-dmrs-to-cpgs-function}
map_dmrs_to_available_cpgs <- function(beta, arraytype, dmr_gr) {
  anno <- get_array_annotation(arraytype)

  common_cpgs <- intersect(rownames(beta), anno$CpG)

  if (length(common_cpgs) == 0) {
    stop("No CpG probes overlapped between the beta matrix and annotation.")
  }

  beta <- beta[common_cpgs, , drop = FALSE]
  anno <- anno[match(common_cpgs, anno$CpG), , drop = FALSE]

  stopifnot(
    identical(rownames(beta), anno$CpG)
  )

  cpg_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = anno$chr,
    ranges = IRanges(
      start = anno$pos,
      end = anno$pos
    ),
    CpG = anno$CpG
  )

  hits <- findOverlaps(dmr_gr, cpg_gr)

  dmr_cpg_list <- split(
    mcols(cpg_gr)$CpG[subjectHits(hits)],
    as.character(queryHits(hits))
  )

  list(
    beta = beta,
    annotation = anno,
    dmr_cpg_list = dmr_cpg_list
  )
}
```

## Define safe summary functions

```{r define-safe-summary-functions}
safe_mean <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}

safe_max <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}

safe_min <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}
```

## Create a result row for a DMR with no available CpGs

```{r define-empty-background-result-function}
empty_background_result <- function(dmr_row, dataset_name) {
  list(
    dataset_summary = data.frame(
  DMR_ID = dmr_row$DMR_ID,
  chr = dmr_row$chr,
  start = dmr_row$start,
  end = dmr_row$end,
  dataset = dataset_name,
  nCpG_background = 0L,
  mean_beta_all_background = NA_real_,
  max_sample_beta = NA_real_,
  min_group_mean_beta = NA_real_,
  background_pass = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
),
    tissue_mean_df = NULL
  )
}
```

## Summarize one DMR in one background dataset

```{r define-summarize-one-background-dmr-function}
summarize_one_background_dmr <- function(
    i,
    dmrs,
    dmr_cpg_list,
    beta,
    pd,
    dataset_name,
    min_bg_cpg,
    beta_threshold) {

  dmr_row <- dmrs[i, , drop = FALSE]
  cpgs <- dmr_cpg_list[[as.character(i)]]

  if (is.null(cpgs)) {
    return(empty_background_result(dmr_row, dataset_name))
  }

  cpgs <- unique(intersect(cpgs, rownames(beta)))

  if (length(cpgs) == 0) {
    return(empty_background_result(dmr_row, dataset_name))
  }

  ## Calculate one regional beta value per sample
  dmr_value <- colMeans(
    beta[cpgs, , drop = FALSE],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  dmr_value[is.nan(dmr_value)] <- NA_real_

  ## Calculate the mean regional beta value within each tissue group
  group_mean <- tapply(
    dmr_value,
    pd$group,
    safe_mean
  )

  tissue_mean_df <- data.frame(
    DMR_ID = dmr_row$DMR_ID,
    chr = dmr_row$chr,
    start = dmr_row$start,
    end = dmr_row$end,
    dataset = dataset_name,
    group = names(group_mean),
    mean_beta = as.numeric(group_mean),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  ## A hypo-DMR passes when it has sufficient CpG coverage and
## every normal tissue-group mean beta is above the predefined threshold.
min_group_mean_beta <- safe_min(group_mean)

background_pass <-
  length(cpgs) >= min_bg_cpg &&
  !is.na(min_group_mean_beta) &&
  min_group_mean_beta > beta_threshold

  dataset_summary <- data.frame(
  DMR_ID = dmr_row$DMR_ID,
  chr = dmr_row$chr,
  start = dmr_row$start,
  end = dmr_row$end,
  dataset = dataset_name,
  nCpG_background = length(cpgs),
  mean_beta_all_background = safe_mean(dmr_value),
  max_sample_beta = safe_max(dmr_value),
  min_group_mean_beta = min_group_mean_beta,
  background_pass = background_pass,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

  list(
    dataset_summary = dataset_summary,
    tissue_mean_df = tissue_mean_df
  )
}
```

## Background-filter one dataset

```{r define-background-filter-one-dataset-function}
background_filter_one_dataset <- function(
    dataset_name,
    rdata_file,
    arraytype,
    dmrs,
    dmr_gr,
    min_bg_cpg,
    beta_threshold) {

  cat("\n", strrep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Background filtering dataset:", dataset_name, "\n")
  cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")

  ## Load and align the ChAMP-filtered data
  myLoad <- load_myLoad_Rdata(rdata_file)
  aligned <- align_background_data(myLoad, dataset_name)

  ## Retain the normal/background samples
  selected <- select_background_samples(
    aligned$beta,
    aligned$pd,
    dataset_name
  )

  beta_bg <- selected$beta
  pd_bg <- selected$pd

  cat("Background sample distribution:\n")
  print(table(pd_bg$group, useNA = "ifany"))

  ## Map the DMR intervals to probes available on this array
  mapped <- map_dmrs_to_available_cpgs(
    beta = beta_bg,
    arraytype = arraytype,
    dmr_gr = dmr_gr
  )

  beta_bg <- mapped$beta
  dmr_cpg_list <- mapped$dmr_cpg_list

  ## Summarize every DMR
  dmr_results <- lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(dmrs)),
    summarize_one_background_dmr,
    dmrs = dmrs,
    dmr_cpg_list = dmr_cpg_list,
    beta = beta_bg,
    pd = pd_bg,
    dataset_name = dataset_name,
    min_bg_cpg = min_bg_cpg,
    beta_threshold = beta_threshold
  )

  dataset_summary <- rbindlist(
    lapply(dmr_results, `[[`, "dataset_summary"),
    fill = TRUE
  )

  tissue_results <- lapply(
    dmr_results,
    `[[`,
    "tissue_mean_df"
  )
  tissue_results <- Filter(Negate(is.null), tissue_results)

  if (length(tissue_results) == 0) {
    tissue_mean_df <- data.table()
  } else {
    tissue_mean_df <- rbindlist(
      tissue_results,
      fill = TRUE
    )
  }

  stopifnot(
    nrow(dataset_summary) == nrow(dmrs)
  )

  list(
    dataset_summary = dataset_summary,
    tissue_mean_df = tissue_mean_df
  )
}
```

# Run background filtering

## Define the background datasets

```{r define-background-datasets}
background_files <- data.frame(
  
  dataset = c("GSE213478","GSE48472"),
  
  file = c("step0.1-GSE213478_output.Rdata","step0.2-GSE48472_output.Rdata"),
  
  arraytype = c("EPIC","450K"),
  
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

background_files$file_exists <- file.exists(background_files$file)

if (!all(background_files$file_exists)) {
  stop(
    "Some background .Rdata files do not exist. Check background_files."
  )
}
```

## Apply the filter to every background dataset

```{r run-background-filtering}
background_outputs <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(background_files)),
  function(i) {
    background_filter_one_dataset(
      dataset_name = background_files$dataset[i],
      rdata_file = background_files$file[i],
      arraytype = background_files$arraytype[i],
      dmrs = dmrs,
      dmr_gr = dmr_gr,
      min_bg_cpg = min_bg_cpg,
      beta_threshold = beta_threshold
    )
  }
)

names(background_outputs) <- background_files$dataset
```

## Combine the dataset-level results

```{r combine-background-results}
background_summary_all <- rbindlist(
  lapply(
    background_outputs,
    `[[`,
    "dataset_summary"
  ),
  fill = TRUE
)

background_tissue_beta_all <- rbindlist(
  lapply(
    background_outputs,
    `[[`,
    "tissue_mean_df"
  ),
  fill = TRUE
)

## Each DMR should appear once in every background dataset
stopifnot(
  nrow(background_summary_all) ==
    nrow(dmrs) * nrow(background_files)
)

table(background_summary_all$dataset)
## Save the dataset-level summary
fwrite(
  background_summary_all,
  file = file.path(
    outdir,
    "background_DMR_beta_summary_by_dataset.csv"
  )
)

fwrite(background_tissue_beta_all,
  file = file.path(outdir,"background_DMR_beta_by_tissue_group.csv"))
```


## Summarize each DMR across all background datasets

```{r summarize-background-across-datasets}
expected_background_datasets <- nrow(background_files)

background_cross_dataset_summary <- background_summary_all[
  ,
  .(
    n_background_datasets = uniqueN(dataset),

    n_background_pass = sum(
      background_pass %in% TRUE
    ),

    min_nCpG_background = safe_min(
      nCpG_background
    ),

    max_nCpG_background = safe_max(
      nCpG_background
    ),

    min_beta_across_background = safe_min(
  min_group_mean_beta),

    mean_beta_across_background = safe_mean(
      mean_beta_all_background
    ),

    background_pass_all =
      uniqueN(dataset) == expected_background_datasets &&
      all(background_pass %in% TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(
    DMR_ID,
    chr,
    start,
    end
  )
]

fwrite(background_cross_dataset_summary,
       file = file.path(outdir,"background_cross_dataset_summary.csv"))
```

## Merge the background results with the original DMR information

```{r merge-background-results-with-dmrs}
final_dmrs <- merge(
  as.data.table(dmrs),
  background_cross_dataset_summary,
  by = c("DMR_ID", "chr", "start", "end"),
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(final_dmrs) == nrow(dmrs)
)

fwrite(
  final_dmrs,
  file = file.path(
    outdir,
    "all_DMRs_with_background_results.csv"
  )
)
```


#### Retain DMRs that pass all background filters

Final criterion:
1. The DMR passes in every background dataset.
2. Every dataset contains at least 6 mapped CpGs.
3. The lowest normal tissue-group mean beta is above 0.20.

```{r retain-background-passed-dmrs}

background_filtered_dmrs <- final_dmrs[
  background_pass_all %in% TRUE &
    min_nCpG_background >= min_bg_cpg &
    min_beta_across_background > beta_threshold
]

fwrite(background_filtered_dmrs,
  file = file.path(outdir,
    "background_filtered_hypo_DMRs_beta_gt_0.2_nCpG_gt5.csv"))
```

## Save all important background-filtering objects

```{r save-background-filtering-rdata}
step3_background_output <- list(
  dmrs = dmrs,
  dmr_gr = dmr_gr,
  background_files = background_files,
  background_summary_all = background_summary_all,
  background_tissue_beta_all = background_tissue_beta_all,
  background_cross_dataset_summary =
    background_cross_dataset_summary,
  final_dmrs = final_dmrs,
  background_filtered_dmrs =
    background_filtered_dmrs,
  beta_threshold = beta_threshold,
  min_bg_cpg = min_bg_cpg,
  robust_dmr_file = robust_dmr_file,
  outdir = outdir,
  session_info = sessionInfo()
)

save(
  step3_background_output,
  file = file.path(
    outdir,
    "step3_background_filtering_output.RData"
  )
)
```
